mapper.select:
SELECT t.title AS trip_title, m.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM diary d INNER JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = d.trip_id LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_id = d.member_id
AND d.diary_id = #{diaryId}

SELECT x.member_id, x.trip_id, t.title AS trip_title FROM (
SELECT mrt.member_id AS member_id, MIN(tr.trip_id) AS trip_id FROM trip tr INNER JOIN member_rel_trip mrt ON mrt.trip_id = tr.trip_id AND mrt.status = 'JOINED'
LEFT JOIN diary d ON d.member_id = mrt.member_id AND d.diary_date = CURDATE() AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status <> 'DELETED')
LEFT JOIN notification n ON n.member_id = mrt.member_id AND n.type = 'DIARY_WRITE_REMINDER' AND n.created_at >= CURDATE()
AND tr.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED')
AND CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(tr.start_date) AND DATE(tr.end_date) AND d.diary_id IS NULL AND n.notification_id IS NULL
GROUP BY mrt.member_id ) x INNER JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = x.trip_id ORDER BY x.member_id
